name: @pipeworx/mcp-help-scout

tools.name: helpscout_list_conversations
tools.description: Return a bounded Help Scout conversation page with subject, customer, inbox, assignee, tags, status, waiting time, and timestamps. Answers which support requests match an account, status, inbox, tag, or search expression.

query.description: Help Scout search expression such as (email:"buyer@example.com")

tools.name: helpscout_get_conversation
tools.description: Return one Help Scout conversation with full customer, inbox, assignee, tag, status, and timing details, optionally embedding its threads. Answers what happened in a specific support case.

include_threads.description: Embed conversation threads; chat text can be truncated by Help Scout

tools.name: helpscout_list_inboxes
tools.description: Return Help Scout inboxes accessible to the token with IDs, names, email addresses, and creation or update timestamps. Answers which support queues can be used for filtering and reporting.

tools.name: helpscout_email_report
tools.description: Return Help Scout email-support volume, replies, response time, first-response time, handle time, resolution time, and first-contact resolution for a bounded date range. Answers whether support load and service performance improved or deteriorated.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-help-scout forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the help-scout pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
